column1: # Canonical collision-free ownership for independent datatype authorities.

column5: The direct FieldType translation preserves raw charset/collation spelling, element and independently owned binary-literal marker slices, ARRAY element semantics, flags/limits/eval classification, parser equality, charset classification, and compact/info/full formatting through the separately translated OutputFormat authority. Hash64, JSON wire fields, Restore/RestoreAsCastType, StorageLength, and MemoryUsage remain unported.

All ten exact Flags bits and accessors, copy-on-write flags/location, non-null warning-sink construction, typed terror warning forwarding, strict/default flag sets, UTC default, and no-op warning context are translated; arbitrary non-terror Go error payloads and time.Location transition rules remain external.

The single Datum authority preserves NULL, signed/unsigned integer, decimal, real, byte-preserving string/bytes, MinNotNull, and MaxValue kinds plus exact NULL < MinNotNull < ordinary scalar < MaxValue ordering. Temporal, enum/set, binary literal, JSON, vector, context-aware ordinary comparison, conversion, hashing, and the rest of datum.go remain external.

The direct FieldType aggregation translation ports the 29x29 merge table including Go's zero-value map index for unknown bytes, mixed-sign integral promotion, flag merging, aggregate EvalType rules, and value-shape inference. Datum integration, type-modification compatibility/reorg diagnostics, varchar length errors, and the rest of this broad source file remain external.

Ports the exact ten-code allowlist, nil handling, unrecognized-error return, ignore-before-warning priority, original-warning forwarding, and strict return policy through the typed conversion context. Generic Go errors.Cause traversal and a unified Rust error sum remain external.

Ports the four-state indent/flat machine, cross-call indentation and dangling-percent NOVERB state, newline flattening, and exact valid-UTF-8 OutputFormat replacements; wider fmt verbs/flags, diagnostics, partial-write accounting, and invalid-UTF8 replacement remain open.
